description: Teacher fine-tuned on the v1.1 TRAIN split only; selection by validation NLL.
protocol: v1.1 evaluator (reproduces whitepaper v1.1 numbers exactly); calibration on validation; group bootstrap 5,000 resamples seed 0; paired deltas vs v1.1 on identical resamples.
selection_rule: lowest validation NLL (unweighted, both heads, T=1) over all done runs

verdict.summary: Pretraining fixes SENTIMENT on every set we have, but not INTENT; negation scope is still unsolved.
verdict.sentiment: Selected teacher (hing-roberta-mixed, lr 5e-5, 278M params) reaches test sentiment macro-F1 1.000 vs 0.845 for v1.1 (paired delta +0.159, 95% CI [+0.056, +0.282], 99.98% of resamples favour the teacher), positive recall 1.00 vs 0.72, emoji pairs 12/12 vs 9/12, stress sentiment F1 1.000 vs 0.826. On the hand-written contrast set sentiment accuracy is 1.00/0.95/1.00/0.90 (negated-negative / negation-scope / neutral-nahi / unseen-affect) vs 0.45/0.90/0.75/0.70 for v1.1: the spurious nahi->negative cue and most unseen affect words are handled. The perfect test score is a ceiling on an easy, generator-style 190-row set (validation sentiment accuracy is 0.943), not evidence of perfection.
verdict.intent: Test intent macro-F1 0.929 vs 0.901 (paired delta +0.032, CI [-0.061, +0.142]): not resolved. Stress intent F1 is 0.852 vs 0.865 and consistency 92.6% vs 97.4%, so the teacher is LESS stable under unseen misspellings than v1.1. Contrast intent accuracy averages 0.775 vs 0.81 for v1.1; errors are keyword-driven (feedback -> not_received/track/damaged; "otp nahi mila" -> not_received).
verdict.negation_scope: Not fixed: 4/10 contrast pairs fully correct (v1.1: 3/10) and the audit error "cancel mat karna sirf order track karke batao" is still predicted cancel_order. Pretraining alone does not supply scope; Phase 2b data must.
verdict.candidates: Emoji visibility matters: hing-bert and MuRIL map all emoji to [UNK] and solve 3-9/12 and 0/12 emoji pairs respectively; MuRIL also converged poorly (validation NLL 1.14-1.30 vs 0.08-0.13 for the hing-roberta models).
verdict.consequence_for_kd: Teacher sentiment soft labels are trustworthy for KD. Intent soft labels need the teacher-v2 data (negation scope, praise-then-request, feedback vs operational) and the 0.6 max-probability mask.
